en: The Path of Discrimination 1,
Great Chapter 1.6.
Discourse on Destinies (Gatikathā)
Through what number of roots as conditions does rebirth occur for one endowed with the perfection of destination and associated with knowledge?

For great wealthy khattiyas, great wealthy brahmins, great wealthy householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere who are associated with knowledge, through how many roots as conditions does rebirth occur?
For the gods of the fine-material sphere, through how many roots as conditions does rebirth occur?
For the gods of the formless realm, through how many causes does rebirth occur?
Rebirth occurs through eight causes associated with knowledge, by way of the excellence of destination.
For great wealthy kshatriyas, great wealthy brahmins, great wealthy householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere realm, rebirth occurs through eight causes associated with knowledge.
The rebirth of the gods of the fine-material sphere occurs conditioned by eight roots.
The rebirth of the gods of the immaterial sphere occurs conditioned by eight roots.
In the attainment of a fortunate destination associated with knowledge, by which eight roots is rebirth conditioned?
At the moment of impulsion of wholesome kamma, the three roots are wholesome;
at that moment, they serve as conascent conditions for the volition born therein.
Therefore it is said:
Conditioned by wholesome roots, there are also volitional formations.
At the moment of attachment, two unwholesome roots exist;
at that moment, they serve as conascence conditions for the volition born together with them.
Therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also have unwholesome roots as their condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are indeterminate.
At that moment, they become co-nascent conditions for the volition that has arisen.
Therefore it is said:
“Consciousness has name-and-form as its condition, and name-and-form has consciousness as its condition.”
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five aggregates are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and dissociation conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four great elements are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, and support conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three formations of vitality are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and dissociation conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, name and form are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these fourteen factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four immaterial aggregates are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five faculties are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, mentality and consciousness are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.

At the moment of rebirth-linking (*paṭisandhi*), these fourteen states are related by way of co-nascence condition (*sahajāta-paccaya*), mutuality condition (*aññamañña-paccaya*), support condition (*nissaya-paccaya*), and association condition (*sampayutta-paccaya*).
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these twenty-eight states are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition (*vippayutta-paccaya*).
Through the attainment of a fortunate destination (*gatisampatti*) associated with knowledge (*ñāṇasampayutta*), rebirth occurs conditioned by these eight roots (*hetu*).

For the great wealthy khattiyas, the great wealthy brahmins, the great wealthy householders, and for the gods of the sense sphere who possess knowledge, by way of which eight roots does rebirth occur as a condition?
At the moment of impulsion of wholesome kamma, three wholesome roots exist;
at that moment, they function as conascence conditions for the volition born therein.
Therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also have wholesome roots as their condition.
At the moment of attachment, two roots are unwholesome.
At that moment, they become co-nascent conditions for the volition that has arisen.
Therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also have unwholesome roots as their condition."
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are indeterminate;
at that moment, they function as conascence conditions for the volition born together with them.
Therefore it is said:
“Consciousness is conditioned by name-and-form, and name-and-form is conditioned by consciousness.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five aggregates are related as co-nascent conditions, mutual conditions, support conditions, and dissociation conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four great elements are related as co-nascent conditions, mutual conditions, and support conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three life-formations are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, both mentality and materiality are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these fourteen factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four formless aggregates are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five faculties are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are related as conascence conditions, mutuality conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, name and consciousness are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these fourteen factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these twenty-eight factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
For great khattiyas, great brahmins, great householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), rebirth occurs by way of these eight roots associated with knowledge.
For the gods of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), by way of which eight roots does rebirth occur?
At the moment of impulsion of wholesome kamma, there are three wholesome roots... [and so on].
The rebirth of the gods of the fine-material sphere occurs due to these eight causes.
For the gods of the immaterial sphere, through what eight causes does rebirth occur?
At the moment of the impulsion of wholesome kamma, there are three wholesome roots.
At that moment, they become co-nascent conditions for the volition that has arisen;
therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also have wholesome roots as their condition."
At the moment of craving, two unwholesome roots exist;
at that moment, they serve as conascent conditions for the volition born therein.
Therefore it is said:
“Volitional formations also [arise] with unwholesome roots as condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are indeterminate;
at that moment, they serve as conascence conditions for the volition born together with them.
Therefore it is said:
“Name is a condition for consciousness, and consciousness is also a condition for name.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four immaterial aggregates are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five faculties are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three roots are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, mentality and consciousness are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these fourteen states are related as co-nascence conditions, mutual conditions, support conditions, and association conditions.
For the gods of the formless realm, rebirth occurs by way of these eight roots as conditions.
By way of how many roots as conditions does rebirth occur for one who possesses a fortunate destination but is dissociated from knowledge?
For great khattiyas, great brahmins, great householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere who are dissociated from knowledge, by how many causes does rebirth occur?
For those dissociated from knowledge, rebirth occurs by way of six causes due to success in destiny.
For great khattiyas, great brahmins, great householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere who are dissociated from knowledge, rebirth occurs by way of six causes.
In the attainment of a fortunate rebirth associated with dissociation from knowledge, through the condition of which six roots does rebirth occur?
At the moment of impulsion of wholesome kamma, two wholesome roots exist;
at that moment, they serve as conascence-conditions for the volition born therein.
Therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also [arise] with wholesome roots as condition.
At the moment of attachment, two roots are unwholesome.
At that moment, they become co-nascent conditions for the volition that has arisen.
Therefore it is said:
"Volitional formations also have unwholesome roots as their condition."
At the moment of rebirth-linking, two roots are indeterminate;
at that moment, they function as conascence conditions for the volition born together with them.
Therefore it is said:
“Consciousness has name-and-form as its condition, and name-and-form has consciousness as its condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the five aggregates are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four great elements are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, and support condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the three formations of vitality are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, mentality and materiality are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these fourteen phenomena are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four formless aggregates are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the four faculties are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, the two roots are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutuality condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, name and consciousness are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutual condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these twelve factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutual condition, support condition, and association condition.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, these twenty-six factors are related by way of co-nascence condition, mutual condition, support condition, and dissociation condition.
In the attainment of a fortunate rebirth (*gatisampatti*) dissociated from knowledge (*ñāṇavippayutta*), rebirth occurs due to these six causes.

For the great wealthy Khattiyas, the great wealthy Brāhmaṇas, the great wealthy householders, and the gods of the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), dissociated from knowledge—due to which six causes does rebirth occur?
At the moment of the impulsion (*javana*) of wholesome karma, there are two wholesome causes.
At that moment, they become co-nascent conditions for the volition that has arisen.
Therefore it is said:
"Conditioned by wholesome roots, there are volitional formations... and so forth.

“For great wealthy khattiyas, great wealthy brahmins, great wealthy householders, and for the gods of the sense-sphere, rebirth occurs through these six causes when they are dissociated from knowledge.
The Discourse on Destinies is concluded.
